title: 16.71. Sanidassanattika, Cittasahabhūduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Anidassanaappaṭighaṁ cittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā cha, ārammaṇe tīṇi …pe… avigate cha.
